editorial: When the surface world feels too bright, this visceral deep-sea thriller plunges you into the overwhelming dread of an uncharted fjord. You won't just be watching a mystery; you'll be feeling the claustrophobic pressure building with the marine biologist's discoveries. While the pacing drags slightly through the investigation of the initial strange occurrences, the payoff arrives with a terrifying atmosphere that never lets up. This intense dive into the depths offers a genuinely unsettling experience, positioning it as a modern survival horror that rewards patience. Ideal for viewers who prefer mounting tension over jump scares.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of biological mysteries and existential dread who appreciate creature features like Alien.
